question: Can two causally retained public capacity alternatives deliver prompt SOC and improve or retain capacity accuracy as later informative use arrives?

case.intervals: Original values, sample order and physical state continuity; no thinning, resampling, resetting or new data generation.

arms.name: coincident_control
arms.initialization: Two identical inherited public local Gaussians, each weight1/2.

arms.name: public_logQ_split
arms.initialization: The fixed public half-Gaussian moment split in the design; no scoring truth or fitted starts.

implementation.remedy: Finite out-of-domain actual rounded coordinate correction gets zero selected gain and matching full Joseph gain; same implementation in both arms.

before_primary: Implement the frozen packed full-factor, mixture, transaction and query contract in a separate module; preserve old candidates.
Pass independent dense prediction/Joseph, rank-deficient, zero-residual and prior subnormal remedy checks; same actual gain for mean and covariance.

Pass coincident-component/no-double-counting, fixed public moments, pre-correction weights, underflow/nonfinite behavior, duplicate/order/source atomicity, missing voltage, whole-bank rejection and recovery checks.
Pass distinct bank/conditional evidence cursor and weight-only availability cases, and local hull evaluation from both actual factors.
Pass deterministic full checkpoint/continuation parity and corrupt/truncated/incompatible atomic restore; preserve first development failures and fixes.
Freeze source, plan, binary, test and resource hashes before either arm starts. Do not open truth in either inference process.

assessment.SOC: Report first available target hit and earliest query after which every remaining saved query meets each target, with query resolution and unavailable periods. Report all selected checkpoints; early lucky accuracy is not a coverage claim.
assessment.capacity: Report the same attainment times without an early deadline, all selected checkpoints and changes in absolute error from900 to1800 and1800 to2100. Separate late informative use from weak-tail retention. No monotonic convergence requirement from finite noisy data.
assessment.local_qualification: Count saved local-provisional hard-error breaches for each component and aggregate; keep application accuracy unresolved uniformly. No label suppression can improve point scores.
assessment.mechanism: Report both components, log weights, full local marginal diagnostics and post-inference oracle-best component to distinguish representation from weighting. Oracle never selects runtime output.
assessment.baseline: Compare selected new coincident and split results with frozen bounded_online_002 control scores without rerunning it. Numerical remedy may differ, so attribute any split benefit only through the paired new arms.
assessment.full_vector: At selected checkpoints report all16 estimated/current-truth coordinates and engineering-scaled errors; nuisance precision is not a separate universal accuracy target.

gates.functional: All targeted invariants and original interval/delivery accounting pass; successful completion with no unexpected event or unreported gap.
gates.numerical: Zero rejected corrections and zero recovery events in the primary; keep failure stages and first outputs if violated.
gates.resource: Owned objects at most7152B plus explicit reserved costs for a10032B design total;10240B ceiling. Known excess fails. Actual M23 stack, math, acquisition and deadline remain open until measured, not assumed passed.
gates.SOC_usefulness: Available aggregate SOC meets the hard limit at900,1800,2100; early acquisition reported separately, not hidden by this coarse gate.
gates.capacity_accuracy_observation: Report whether each declared target is attained and retained at1800/2100. This is observed finite-trace performance, not a startup deadline or eventual-convergence proof.
gates.promotion: No full promotion from this one case. A point pass cannot validate coverage, restore all historical evidence or qualify indefinite operation.

decision_rules: Any numerical, evidence-accounting or known resource failure rejects the implementation for continuation until that concrete failure is resolved.
A useful second component with inaccurate aggregate identifies a weighting/output problem; two similarly wrong components identify failure of this split to retain a useful alternative on this trace.
Capacity error improving with later stimulus supports continued learning on this finite trace; no5% hit means capacity remains unresolved, not that all longer operation must fail.
Capacity regression or plateau, especially with wrong narrow precision, is evidence against assuming duration alone repairs the approximation. Name the missing mechanism before a longer campaign.
Passing both new arms without meaningful split benefit does not establish a need for the second component. Preserve all outcomes and original gates.
stop: One complete predeclared two-arm2100s comparison, then a concrete keep/reject/unresolved mechanism decision and compact handoff. No post-outcome horizon, starts, component count, noise or prior sweep; no annual run. A later longer experiment requires its own continuous-trajectory and retained-evidence contract.
